sources.primary_title: NetApp to showcase how the NetApp platform enables AI-ready data, unified storage, proactive protection and complete control at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, NetApp is showcasing its Intelligent Data Infrastructure platform, emphasizing its ability to make enterprise data AI-ready and secure across hybrid-multi-cloud environments. The announcement highlights NetApp's strategic focus on the Saudi Arabian market, aligning with the Kingdom's designation of 2026 as the Year of Artificial Intelligence. Key executives, including Suhail Hasanain (Senior Director and General Manager, MEA) and Saeed Alzahrani (Country Manager, Saudi Arabia), stressed the shift from AI experimentation to large-scale production and the necessity of embedding security directly into data rather than just the perimeter. NetApp is demonstrating autonomous, AI-driven defense mechanisms designed for rapid threat detection and data recovery. This angle is distinct as it specifically details NetApp's localized strategic push and technological focus for the Saudi market at LEAP 2026, moving beyond general product features to address regional AI infrastructure demands.
sources.verified_key_facts: NetApp is participating in LEAP 2026 from August 31 to September 3 at the Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Center (RECC); The company is showcasing its Intelligent Data Infrastructure platform for hybrid-multi-cloud environments; The focus is on making enterprise data AI-ready and securing it with autonomous, AI-driven defense mechanisms; Suhail Hasanain, Senior Director and General Manager, MEA at NetApp, emphasized Saudi Arabia's emergence as a key AI market; Saeed Alzahrani, Country Manager, Saudi Arabia at NetApp, highlighted the need for data security embedded directly into the data itself rather than just the perimeter; The announcement aligns with Saudi Arabia designating 2026 as the Year of Artificial Intelligence.
